redfin.remarks: Welcome to 12000 Goshen Avenue, the premier Brentwood contemporary condo community. Upon arriving, prepare to be impressed by the modern architecture, sleek glass, and metal lines framed by towering palm trees. Ascend the elevator to find this spacious, remodeled home ready for you to move right in and enjoy. The living space is upgraded with gleaming light maple hardwood flooring, neutral paint, crown molding, recessed lighting, and a Nest thermostat. Incredibly open for effortless entertaining, a granite countertop bar runs the length of the kitchen and connects the dining room. This chic kitchen features abundant white cabinetry, geometric white tile, and high-end stainless steel appliances including a Bosch gas cooktop and refrigerator. Continue into the inviting living room, with a gas fireplace, that flows out through a sliding glass door to your own private balcony located off the street. The living space is complete with a rare half bathroom for your guests to utilize. Ideally situated adjacent to the bedrooms is the convenient laundry closet that even comes with the washer and dryer. Both bedrooms offer dedicated full bathrooms, newer flooring, and dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows for letting in beautiful natural lighting. The bedroom suites also offer their own closets and are separated by a generous walk-in closet with built-ins. This home includes 2 secure tandem parking spaces, a large private storage unit ideal for bulky items, as well as a shared gym. Access is controlled to this well-maintained building with recent association upgrades incorporating the ButterflyMX video intercom system. Excellent walkability to lively restaurants and cool shopping, or hop on a bike just a few miles to the sunny shores of Santa Monica Beach. This coveted neighborhood is also close to Century City/Hollywood with quick freeway access taking you anywhere you want to go in LA.
